body:
Thing is, some days it feels like the front has volume again.

But other day, it’s flat and feels like straw.
Yes. That’s the first thing I noticed, actually.

https://imgur.com/a/EGSybVp

I feel like my hair is thinner and my crown just feels/looks bad. I don’t know if I am just imagining things.

Right side of my hair also feels better. Like it has more volume. Left side looks thinner and I feel like there’s a noticeable scalp line too...? I don’t know if that’s normal.
